low-k tier on a thick substrate is NOT one
first-order node, so the lumped curve

fill: #0b0b0b; font: 12.4px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Duty cycle, not peak P/E, sets the 3D SRAM tier's thermal envelope
Llama-3.1-8B decode, B=8 N=2048, C2 2-layer 800 mm2 = 4.22 GB. Tier serves 24% of a 17.16 GB/step demand at 19 TB/s -> active 4.8% of a 4.515 ms step.
E/bit, R_th and C_th are unmeasured and are swept, never assumed. Decode is the verified thermal worst case: prefill duty is 0.08-0.41% (scripts/prefill_phase.py).
